title: O biscoito e o segredo
summary: Malu cobra o biscoito escondido por Laranjito. As desculpas dele revelam que uma visita inesperada chegou ao bairro: o irmão de Malu voltou, apesar de um conflito antigo ainda não resolvido.

shots.speaker: malu
shots.text: Vai esconder esse biscoito atrás das costas? Eu estou vendo, Laranjito.
shots.acting: The apple woman questions the orange man with narrowed eyes and a small open-palm gesture. He reacts guiltily, still hiding the same biscuit. Neither changes position.

shots.speaker: laranjito
shots.text: Calma, Malu. Isso não é o que parece. Deixa eu explicar.
shots.acting: The orange man looks camera-left toward the apple woman, nervous and defensive, one small eyebrow lift and a tiny pleading head tilt. Biscuit stays behind his back.

shots.speaker: malu
shots.text: É o último biscoito da dona Cida. Eu guardei para a visita!
shots.acting: The apple woman holds a skeptical gaze camera-right, one eyebrow raised, then glances briefly at his hidden hand and back to his eyes. Keep her palm open.

shots.speaker: laranjito
shots.text: Talvez seja o que parece. Mas eu tive um bom motivo.
shots.acting: The orange man offers a sheepish uncertain smile, then hesitates, eyebrows falling as he searches for an excuse. Restrained head motion, same stance and biscuit.

shots.speaker: malu
shots.text: Espero que seja melhor do que a desculpa que você inventou ontem.
shots.acting: The apple woman gives an unimpressed patient stare, lips pressed then relaxed, slight head tilt and a small impatient palm gesture.

shots.speaker: laranjito
shots.text: Eu só provei um pedacinho. Precisava garantir que estava bom.
shots.acting: The orange man tries to look confidently innocent while the apple woman reacts with disbelief. Both retain the exact original positions, clothes and fruit faces.

shots.speaker: malu
shots.text: Você protegeu o biscoito com a boca? Era um presente!
shots.acting: The apple woman raises a questioning eyebrow, disbelieving, then gives a tiny incredulous head shake. Her expression is frustrated but comic, not aggressive.

shots.speaker: laranjito
shots.text: Já resolvi! Levei um pacote novo para a dona Cida.
shots.acting: The orange man raises his eyebrows and makes a small reassuring gesture with his free hand, relieved to have an answer, then checks her reaction camera-left.

shots.speaker: malu
shots.text: Você levou? Em que hora? Eu passei lá e estava fechado.
shots.acting: The apple woman becomes curious rather than angry, turns her gaze slightly back toward his eyes, head subtly tilting as she asks a specific question.

shots.speaker: laranjito
shots.text: Hoje cedo. Ela estava com alguém na varanda. Você não sabia?
shots.acting: The orange man grows hesitant, glances down briefly and back camera-left, realizing he has said something important. Maintain exact head shape and facial texture.

shots.speaker: malu
shots.text: Ela disse que não esperava ninguém. Quem estava lá, Laranjito?
shots.acting: The apple woman's annoyed expression changes to serious suspicion. Her eyes widen slightly and her open palm pauses, gaze fixed camera-right.

shots.speaker: laranjito
shots.text: Essa pessoa perguntou por você. Perguntou se ainda morava aqui.
shots.acting: The orange man becomes cautious and sober while the apple woman watches closely. Tiny coordinated breathing and blinks, no walking, no props appearing.

shots.speaker: malu
shots.text: Olha para mim e fala. Quem perguntou por mim?
shots.acting: The apple woman fixes a firm emotional gaze camera-right and lowers her raised eyebrow, waiting seriously for an answer. Hands remain anatomically stable.

shots.speaker: laranjito
shots.text: Eu prometi não contar. Mas você precisa saber.
shots.acting: The orange man hesitates, takes a subtle breath and looks back at the apple woman, concerned, no smile, gentle movement only.

shots.speaker: malu
shots.text: Depois de tudo que aconteceu, eu não aguento mais segredo.
shots.acting: The apple woman looks hurt rather than angry, brows lifting at the center, lips softening, small controlled breath, gaze camera-right.

shots.speaker: laranjito
shots.text: Seu irmão, Malu. Ele voltou. Com a mesma mala de quando foi embora.
shots.acting: The orange man delivers a serious revelation with a steady concerned gaze camera-left, a small downward nod, then remains still while watching her reaction. No new person or suitcase appears.

shots.speaker: malu
shots.text: Meu irmão? Ele prometeu que nunca mais pisaria nesta rua.
shots.acting: The apple woman reacts to an unexpected family revelation: eyes widen, brows lift, then her expression becomes conflicted and hurt. Slow subtle motion, keep same identity and clothing.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Ela veio cobrar um biscoito. E descobriu que o passado estava de volta.
shots.acting: The apple woman looks stunned and thoughtful while the orange man watches her with concern. Warm street remains still, dramatic restrained reaction, no walking or new objects.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Qual decisão você tomaria? Comente e acompanhe o próximo capítulo desta história original.
shots.acting: Both original characters remain in the same street, exchanging a quiet concerned look. Subtle natural breathing and one blink, stable fixed camera, no text.
